trades.reasoning: Top-scoring candidate (100) with full multi-signal confirmation — MACD bullish crossover, RSI 66.9 in bullish zone, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — on a risk-on day (NASDAQ +1.2%).

decisions.briefing: Markets are risk-on today with NASDAQ up 1.2% and the S&P 500 up 0.6%. We deployed available cash into AMZN, the only candidate showing all four bullish confirmation signals including a volume surge, while holding our existing winners steady.

market_education.summary_en: Tech and broader equities rallied today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500 as growth stocks led gains. Breadth was positive and volume picked up in several momentum names, consistent with risk appetite returning to the market. No major negative catalysts were evident, allowing bullish technical setups to extend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股帶動大市造好，納斯達克指數升幅跑贏標普500指數，顯示增長股再次成為市場焦點。多隻具動能的股份成交量明顯放大，反映資金風險偏好回升。市場未見明顯利淡消息，令原有的技術性好友訊號得以延續。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to all line up before buying, rather than acting on just one. This reduces the chance of chasing a false breakout.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「動能確認」是指在買入前，等待多個技術訊號（例如MACD金叉、RSI處於健康水平、股價高於均線，以及成交量放大）同時出現，而不是單憑一個訊號就進場。這樣可以減少追入「假突破」的風險。
